name: tool_list
description:
List or search available tools. Use with no arguments to see all tools, or provide a query to search by name, description, or parameter.

Returns compact summaries: name, group, one-line description, parameter names, and required fields.

Use tool_get to load the full definition of a specific tool.

query.description: Search term matched against tool name, description, and parameter names. Omit to list all tools.

group.description: Filter results to a specific tool group. Valid values are the directory names listed in groups.json at the tools package root.
